items.summary: Recommendation: continue and finish the existing bounded, reversible work on saveusfarms.com, aliencouncil.com, marineactivity.com, fishhooklabs.com, stinkyleftfoot.com, and related active streams; create no duplicate queue tasks. The 30-day SEO window through 2026-09-23 shows 13,177 impressions, 126 clicks, 932 sessions, and 13 conversions. Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21, but site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because one tracking ID is unmapped and direct costs are unavailable. The main unknown is which sites can produce attributable contribution margin. Smallest next step: complete active baselines and measure deployed changes after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner question: for SearchWoot choose A) keep private, B) approve preparation of an unsent Woot permission request, or C) end the public-beta pursuit.
